description: This file defines a template class for generating uniformly distributed random integers over a specified inclusive range, including methods for parameter management, serialization, and internal generation logic.

classes.name: absl::uniform_int_distribution
classes.description: Template class for generating uniform integer distributions over a specified range.

classes.name: absl::uniform_int_distribution::param_type
classes.description: Parameter class encapsulating the range bounds for the distribution.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random integer within the distribution's range using a provided generator.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the distribution state; has no effect in this implementation.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution range.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution range.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Gets or sets the distribution parameters.
